name: comp-242
title: Square Thumb Slider
blurb: Slider with a square-shaped thumb instead of the default round one.
description: A single-value slider variant with a square thumb handle for a geometric aesthetic.
use_when: Matching a design system that uses square handles over rounded ones.
avoid_when: Accessibility concerns with square shapes; typically rounded is more expected.
a11y: Standard slider keyboard support. Square shape may be less recognizable as draggable.
